title: Well-posedness and asymptotic behavior of solutions to a second order nonlocal parabolic MEMS equation
summary: We consider a second-order nonlocal parabolic MEMS equation with Dirichlet boundary conditions: \[ u_t-Δu=\fracλ{(1-u)^2\bigl(1+\int_Ω\frac{1}{1-u}\,dx\bigr)^2},\quad x\inΩ,\ t>0, \] where \(Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^N\) \((1\le N\le3)\) is a bounded smooth domain and \(λ>0\). Using operator semigroups and the contraction mapping principle, we prove local existence and give a quenching criterion. Under suitable smallness conditions on \(λ\) and the initial data, global existence and exponential convergence to the minimal steady state are obtained.
